response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong engineering fundamentals and 15+ years of software development experience, he is fundamentally misaligned for this embedded networking firmware security role. His career has been predominantly web/full-stack focused (JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js) rather than embedded systems or firmware. He lacks demonstrated experience in security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption), networking protocols (NETCONF, SNMP), Linux kernel modification, and switch/LAN product development. Most critically, he does not list Japanese language proficiency, which is a stated required qualification at native level.
strengths: 15+ years of proven software development experience with progression to senior/staff levels, well exceeding the 3+ years requirement
Demonstrated experience with C/C++ and Linux system-level work including audio servers and infrastructure automation
Strong engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship showing ability to write quality code
concerns: Missing Japanese language proficiency (native level required), creating a critical blocker for communication with Japan-based teams
Career trajectory is primarily web/full-stack development (JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js) with no demonstrated embedded firmware or LAN/switch product experience
No evidence of security technologies expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, authentication systems) or networking protocol stack implementation (NETCONF, SNMP, Telemetry)

key_factors.factor: No embedded networking firmware or security product experience
Recent 10+ years focused on web/full-stack development, not embedded systems
